selection_basis: predeclared source observability, no inference scores or pose outputs inspected
access: Normal public Brightcove player; no login, cookies, DRM or bot bypass
rights: Copyright retained by publisher; no open redistribution license claimed. Local validation only; original media excluded from Git/public evidence.

source_media.time_mode: real-time first match presentation; later slow replay excluded

reviewed_subject.description_zh: 近端酒红色裙装运动员，追向画面右侧；远端黄衣对手。姓名不作为源标签依据。
reviewed_subject.racket_hand_basis_zh: 6.60至6.92秒连续后斜视图中，右臂由肩后持拍前伸到身体右前方，另一左臂向后上方展开；拍柄与右手连续相连。未按运动员姓名推断。
reviewed_subject.mirror_status: no horizontal mirror indicated by readable court text; anatomical side visually reviewed

positive_actions.observations_zh: 6.44–6.64持拍高于肩侧追球；6.72–6.84右臂向右前方伸展，拍面开放、球拍从高位降至低前方，6.80附近可见球与拍面接近，6.84球向前离开；6.88–7.08屈膝承重并收回球拍恢复。独立原图支持真实单手正手切削，不据标题标注。

negative_intervals.label: recovery_repositioning_no_new_stroke
negative_intervals.reason_zh: 同一拍结束后的追步和恢复，不应另算完整击球。

limitations: Original near subject about 100–120 pixels high; wrist/handle detail limited by motion blur and 25 fps.
Broadcast court view is near end-on with camera motion; independent forward/up separability is not asserted.
Later enlarged replay is same action and not real-time evidence.

context_intervals.label: preceding_rally_context_not_part_of_slice_positive
context_intervals.reason_zh: 包含前一底线击球动作后的位移；本次已冻结正例仅6.44–7.08秒切削，不能把此前回合动作并为同拍。
